snippet.title: Borrowed Flesh – Cinematic Trailer | Grim Roguelike Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887970/

Unimaginable horrors awaited them.

Borrowed Flesh is a grim roguelike deckbuilder. Lead a doomed party down into a world of rotting flesh, where every wound stays, every mind can break, and death is permanent.

Turn-based card combat meets dark fantasy horror: build a deck from your party of heroes, push them through stress and madness, and survive permadeath runs down a cursed descent.

Wishlist Borrowed Flesh on Steam to follow the descent.

#roguelike #deckbuilder #horrorgame #indiegame #darkfantasy
